'''Ruby''' is the owner of the Inner Inn. Her son [[Rock (DS)|Rock]] doesn't help his mother at home, and her husband is out traveling the world, so Ruby is left to do all the work on her own. She spends every day at the Inn, with the exception of Tuesdays when she goes to Mineral Town to do her shopping. She's a great host who is always cheerful and friendly, and is somewhat famous for her great cooking. [[Nami (DS)|Nami]] lives at the Inn, and Ruby thinks of her as a daughter. If you connect ''DS'' with ''[[Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town]]'' (or ''Cute'' with ''[[Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral Town]]'') via GBA slot on your DS, the rooms on the second floor will be open and some of the Mineral Town visitors may stay there. ==Schedule== {| class="storyschedule_table" |- !
